$comment: VAPP-85 (D14): the ONE table from the A2UI basic catalog (vendor/a2ui/v0_9/basic_catalog.json) onto the core catalog. The reducer (src/reducer.ts, mirrored by the Rust core) applies it so painters never learn a second vocabulary; fixtures/catalog-basic-map.json locks the result. Per component: `to` = the core component, `props` = { coreProp: basicProp | {from, map?, default?} | {const} }, `children` = which basic field holds the child ids (`children` | `child`), `transform` = a NAMED structural step the reducer implements in code (listed under `transforms`, with what it does, so a second implementation knows the rules). A2UI dynamic values (`{path}` bindings, function calls) pass through untouched. `icons` maps the basic Icon names onto icons.json names (concept ids or registry Lucide names); `null` = no equivalent in the registry, painted as the placeholder icon `ui-icon-placeholder`. `functions` = identity, the core catalog exposes the same 14. A basic component absent from `components` becomes the `Unknown` placeholder (never an error).

transforms.textVariant: variant h1..h4 → Heading{level}; h5 → Text{variant: label}; caption → Text{variant: caption}; body or absent → Text{variant: body}.
transforms.imageVariant: variant avatar → Avatar{src: url, name: description}; icon → style width/height 24; smallFeature → style width/height 120; mediumFeature or absent → style width 100%, aspectRatio 1.7777778; largeFeature → the same; header → style width 100%, aspectRatio 3.
transforms.iconName: name string → icons[name] (null or absent → placeholderIcon); name {path} (a custom glyph) → placeholderIcon.
transforms.tabs: tabs[i] → props.tabs[i] = {label: title, value: child id}; children = the tab child ids in order; value = the first tab's child id.
transforms.modal: trigger → slots.trigger; content → children[0]; props.open = false.
transforms.buttonChild: child Text → props.label = its text (the Text node is consumed); child Icon → props.icon = the mapped icon name (consumed); any other child → children[0]; action → on.press (an A2UI Action verbatim); size icon when icon and no label.
transforms.textField: name = id; variant longText → Textarea{label, value, checks}; number → Input{type: number}; obscured → Input{type: password}; shortText or absent → Input{type: text}; validationRegexp → one more check {condition: {call: regex, args: {value: {path: <the value binding's path, or the id>}, pattern}}, message: 'Invalid value'}.
transforms.choicePicker: name = id; options keep label/value; value (a list) → the first entry for single choice, comma-joined for multiple; filterable → Select{searchable: true, multiple: variant == multipleSelection}; else displayStyle chips → ToggleGroup{type: single|multiple by variant, variant: outline, items: options}; else variant multipleSelection → Select{multiple: true}; else → Radio.
